title.it: Attacco contro l’ambasciata israeliana a Stoccolma: attribuzione OFAC a Foxtrot su incarico iraniano
title.en: Attack on the Israeli embassy in Stockholm: OFAC attributes it to Foxtrot acting on Iranian instructions

description.it: OFAC sostiene che Foxtrot organizzò l’attacco per conto dell’Iran. Si tratta di attribuzione USA, distinta da sentenza sul mandato.
description.en: OFAC states that Foxtrot organised the attack on behalf of Iran. This is a US attribution, distinct from a court ruling on who ordered it.

notes: Themes assigned editorially: the record has no original category.
